content.text: CBS Cancels 7 TV Shows in 2025, Announces 2 Are Ending in 2026, & Renews Several HitsCBS is ending 2025 with a few big TV show renewals, after all of those cancellations were announced.Just recently, two freshman TV dramas were given very early renewals just weeks into their runs on the network. In addition, you may not realize that one of the big hit comedies on CBS will be coming to an end in 2026.With renewal news also comes cancellation updates.
